remit: fade statistically or fundamentally stretched market moves when reversal conditions exist
stance_summary: Do not fade US 2Y just because it prints a 252-day high: it sits on the live SR3 path after a delivered, pre-priced hike with still-hot US gauges. The stretched object with a reversal condition is Australia: AU 2Y 4.999 as of 2026-09-16 sits through live AONIA (overnight 4.35; Oct-26 4.565; Mar-27 4.86; path peak 4.945) after 16 Sep housing evidence that the tightening channel is already biting. Fade the remaining 21-51bp of priced RBA hikes in the AONIA strip, not AUDUSD.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Short/receive AONIA Oct-26, Nov-26 and Mar-27 strip (paper mark: futures_strip_average on AONIA expiries 2026-10, 2026-11, 2027-03; lead bookable contract AONIA_2026-10 at implied 4.565). Alternative rates candidate considered and rejected as inferior: receive CORRA 2027 strip because CA-US 2Y at -140bp is close to the CORRA-SOFR overnight gap of -156bp, so that 5y 4th-percentile spread is mostly the justified policy differential, not an independent overshoot, and CA 2Y 5y percentile is only 58.6.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Short AUDUSD at ECB 0.712022367194781 (1y percentile 76.4, 5y 84.3, 1m return +0.20 percent). Not statistically stretched; embeds USD, China/risk and commodity residual that do not own the AONIA-versus-housing discrepancy.
expression_comparison.rationale: The mispricing lives in remaining RBA hike premium versus a working housing channel, measured against the live AONIA path and AU 2Y through that path. AUDUSD is not the stretched object. Rates are comparably clean and are the default. AONIA_2026-10 is the liquid first extra-hike contract (implied 4.565, +21.5bp vs overnight 4.35, open interest 21752, volume 4450); Nov-26 4.685 and Mar-27 4.86 complete the same hike-delivery window. Paper futures are marked in implied-rate space, so the position is short implied AONIA (receive / rates down).

context_build.causal_mechanism: RBA cash is already restrictive at AONIA 4.35. Incremental tightening is transmitted through housing turnover, prices and state tax receipts with a lag. Once that channel is contracting, inflation-gauge heat that is already in the price cannot by itself justify another 21-51bp of hikes. The testable claim is that the live AONIA strip still prices that extra tightening as if the housing channel were not yet binding.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Verified path: AU 2Y rose 39.1bp over 1M to 4.999 as of 2026-09-16 (252-day percentile 99.2, z 1.68; 1y percentile 99.0; 5y percentile 99.8). AU 5Y 5.041 and AU 10Y 5.348 sit at the same 99th 1y / 99.8th 5y corner. Over the same window AONIA overnight is 4.35 (17-Sep-2026). The ASX 30-day strip prices Oct-26 4.565 (+21.5bp), Nov-26 4.685 (+33.5bp), Dec-26 4.725 (+37.5bp), Mar-27 4.86 (+51bp) and a 2027 peak of 4.945 (+59.5bp). The 16 Sep housing research is the local information; the 16 Sep Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00 percent, which futures had >90 percent priced, is the global duration-supply overlay. US 2Y 4.76 as of 2026-09-18 matches 12m SR3U7 4.755, so the US front end is path-consistent; AU 2Y 4.999 is 13.9bp through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86 and 5.4bp through the AONIA peak 4.945.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known: AU inflation gauge 82, AONIA already 4.35, and a Fed hike that was >90 percent priced into 16 Sep. Those facts can explain a restrictive starting point, not a new 21-51bp of extra RBA hikes. New as of 16 Sep: NSW stamp-duty receipts -24 percent year over year, transaction volumes -18 percent, Sydney and Melbourne values more than 7 percent below peak. That is a new transmission of already-known tightening. Unknown: live CFTC/CME positioning (unavailable this freeze); whether subsequent CPI/trimmed-mean re-accelerates from the packet's inflation-gauge 82 without new housing confirmation.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: AONIA prices the RBA to deliver about +21.5bp by Oct-26, +33.5bp by Nov-26 and +51bp by Mar-27, with a 2027 terminal near 4.945, despite the housing contraction. AU 2Y at 4.999 assumes that path plus a further sovereign premium through the live strip. US SR3 still prices +47bp by Dec-26 (4.32) and +90.5bp by Sep-27 (4.755) from SOFR 3.85; that US path is not this trade's object.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The priced assumption that is wrong is that the RBA can still deliver the remaining Oct-Mar AONIA hikes, and that AU 2Y should sit through that path, after the housing channel has already broken. This is not a claim that AONIA 4.35 itself is too high, and it is not a fade of US 2Y 4.76, which is on the SR3 path with US inflation/labor/activity/consumer gauges 72/75/69/74.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level versus change: AONIA 4.35 is the restrictive level (state); the trade owns the change still priced in Oct-Nov-Mar implied rates (+21.5/+33.5/+51bp). Tenor: front-end policy, not AU 10Y 5.348 term premium. Marginal driver of the recent AU 2Y 1M +39bp is hike-path extrapolation after hot inflation (gauge 82) plus global duration supply from the delivered Fed hike, not a new Australian activity boom (activity 54, consumer 48, labor 50). AU 2Y through Mar-27 AONIA is the sovereign-versus-path residual; short AONIA owns the path residual that housing should close first. Dec-26 AONIA (4.725, volume 2) is too thin to be a lead contract and is omitted from the strip.

analogs: Packet AU 2Y tenor analog list is empty; no dedicated RBA-housing-pause twin is stored. Use the AU-US 2Y 1m-move analogs at a -11.5bp prior 1m move (as_of 2026-09-16, spread +25.9bp, 1y percentile 25.6): 2022-02-07 continued -11.7bp over 1m then +38.9bp over 3m; 2024-12-30 went -8.7bp / +11.8bp; 2026-04-23 went -41.3bp / -54.7bp; 2025-07-30 reversed +32.7bp / +58.6bp. Forward outcomes are mixed, which is why housing transmission, not the percentile, is the thesis.

Same-move CA-US 2Y analogs at a -17bp 1m cheapening (2022-11-15, 2025-01-30, 2024-05-02, 2024-12-18) also mix 1m continuation with 3m mean-reversion (2025-01-30 printed +25bp over 3m from -145bp). They caution against fading CA-US 2Y on rank alone and are not used as the AU analog.
historical_reference.regime_differences: Inflation gauge 82 is hotter than a textbook late-cycle housing pause, so this is not an easing call and not a short of AONIA overnight 4.35. The Fed has just delivered 25bp and SR3 still prices further US tightening, so global duration supply can keep AU yields bid even if the RBA pauses. AU 2Y observation is three days stale versus the 2026-09-19T21:40:00Z cutoff; AONIA is the live tradable path. Temperature gauges are dashboard_v8 retained. Mixed analog 3m outcomes mean the housing prints, not the 99th percentile, must do the work.

Labor/activity/consumer gauges 50/54/48 are mid-to-cool against inflation 82, so the inflation gauge is not corroborated by the activity side of the same dashboard.

The AU 2Y / AONIA move cannot be attributed to documented crowding, CTA, or dealer plumbing. trade.structure: Short implied-rate / receive AONIA hike-delivery window. Lead markable contract AONIA_2026-10 (packet implied_rate 4.565, price 95.435, source ASX_30D_AONIA). Locked strip for the same view: {"type":"futures_strip_average","curve_id":"AONIA","expiries":["2026-10","2026-11","2027-03"]}. Paper futures are marked in implied-rate space, so direction is short the implied rate. Not an executable broker ticket. Family locked to AONIA until close; do not migrate onto AU_2Y.
trade.thesis: FACT: 16 Sep housing evidence shows NSW stamp-duty -24 percent y/y, volumes -18 percent, Sydney/Melbourne >7 percent off peak while AONIA still prices Oct-26 4.565 and Mar-27 4.86 from overnight 4.35, and AU 2Y 4.999 sits through that path. INFERENCE: crowded extrapolation of inflation-gauge 82 plus the delivered Fed hike has overshot the RBA's remaining hike capacity now that the housing channel is binding; the extra 21-51bp should be faded. UNKNOWN: positioning and the next CPI vintage. This is not a US 2Y fade and not an AONIA-easing call.
trade.mispricing: The market prices another +21.5bp by Oct-26 and +51bp by Mar-27 in AONIA, and AU 2Y 4.999 is 13.9bp through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86, after housing volumes and prices have already broken. The 99th-percentile AU 2Y rank is the discovery flag, not the thesis. The mispricing is remaining hike premium versus a working tightening channel, versus the live AONIA path.
why_now: 16 Sep housing research is dated new transmission of known RBA tightening; the Fed hike that day was already >90 percent priced and is now delivered, so it is not a fresh AU-hike catalyst.
AU 2Y as of 2026-09-16 prints through live Mar-27 AONIA 4.86 and through the AONIA peak 4.945; that sovereign-versus-path residual is open at the 2026-09-19T21:40:00Z freeze.

Funded seats pay official SOFR 3.85 ACT/360 on the full $100m even if flat; fading 21-51bp of extra AONIA hike premium with a defined housing invalidation is the seat's attempt to clear that hurdle rather than sit in cash.
evidence_refs: rollup:Australian housing downturn deepens under higher rates
trade.horizon: 1-3 months, through the Oct-26 and Nov-26 AONIA windows and the next Australian housing/labor prints
trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if live AONIA holds or lifts the packet Oct-26 4.565 and Mar-27 4.86 prints while housing/labor stop confirming the channel is biting (stamp-duty, volumes, prices, employment) or while the AU inflation gauge remains 82 with activity/consumer reheating from 54/48. A delivered October RBA hike that reprices Oct-26 and Nov-26 implied rates higher, or Mar-27 AONIA rising through the packet AU 2Y 4.999, also invalidates. Right-thesis/wrong-timing if AU-US 2Y analog 2025-07-30 (+32.7bp 1m) repeats as global duration supply; then keep the 1-3 month horizon rather than treat one-week noise as a stop. No executable numeric stop is in the packet.
catalysts: Next Australian housing, prices, stamp-duty and labor prints confirming the 16 Sep contraction.
RBA communication that treats the housing channel as binding and declines to deliver the remaining Oct-Mar AONIA hikes.
AU 2Y giving back the residual through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86 as the path, not the inflation narrative, reasserts.
principal_risks: Inflation gauge 82 is a live hawkish offset; a re-acceleration in trimmed-mean/CPI can make the extra 51bp necessary rather than stretched.
Delivered Fed hike and still-rising SR3 path (4.32 Dec, 4.755 Sep-27) can keep global front-end yields bid and delay AONIA mean reversion.
AU 2Y analog list is empty and AU-US 2Y forward outcomes are mixed; housing may be priced faster in activity gauges than in the AONIA strip.
Positioning unknown (CFTC/CME unavailable). Oct is liquid but Mar-27 AONIA open interest is only 201 with volume 1, so the back of the strip is a thin paper mark.
AU 2Y as_of 2026-09-16 is stale versus the cutoff; if the sovereign has already retraced toward AONIA, the through-the-path residual may be gone.
